message.content: The three anchors are up. Which one, and why?

content.text:
All three read as instruments rather than dashboards, which is the bar.

I'll go with the chain-and-serif blend rather than the third anchor, because the struck-through refusals are the strongest device in any of them and the third one loses them. We could keep the accent stripe as well, but it does double duty with drift and I would rather fix that than defend it.

One defect present in all three that I'll fix regardless of the pick: red is marking rejected alternatives and flagging drift at the same time.

Contrast is clean. Let me check the rendered pass too rather than trust the token matrix.

We're not shipping a hero image; the screens carry the page on their own, and a generated hero would be the one asset nobody could regenerate.
